mem.9:
Evan and Sam conversation memory (dates absolute; unknown details kept unspecified)

- Before 18 May 2023, Evan’s old Prius broke down; Evan had it repaired and sold it, then recently returned from a family trip in a new Prius. During the week before 18 May, Evan and family visited the Rockies and hiked.
- When Sam was 10, Sam went on a memorable, fun hike with Sam’s father and recalls hiking a considerable distance.
- As of 18 May, Sam had not settled on a hobby and was considering painting but had not tried it. Evan had enjoyed watercolor painting for a few years after a friend introduced him, offered advice, and sparked his enthusiasm. Evan said painting relieved stress.
- 20–21 May: Evan took his family on a road trip to Jasper, drove the Icefields Parkway, and enjoyed glaciers, lakes, and a cozy cabin amid mountains and forests.
- 24 May: Evan shared a photo described as a person holding a book in front of a lake, while saying he had taken a glacier photo. A few days earlier, Sam had a doctor’s check-up and found the weight measurement concerning and eye-opening. Sam was considering painting to stay motivated and asked if it could help with stress. Evan said painting brought peace and creative expression, encouraged Sam to try it, and recommended exercise for weight management. He advised finding enjoyable fitness and making small healthier food choices. Sam said they would try painting without stressing over it and report back.
- Week of 29 May: Evan had a sudden heart palpitation that frightened him and was a wake-up call about lifestyle. On 6 June, he said he was trying to eat less processed food and fewer sugary snacks, though he loved ginger snaps. Sam wanted to eat healthier but had not changed their diet and still enjoyed soda and candy. Sam agreed to try flavored seltzer instead of soda and high-cocoa dark chocolate instead of candy. Sam asked for exercise help; Evan offered to meet and demonstrate basic exercises, encouraged small changes, and said exercise clears the mind. Sam was in a terrible mood after finding all supermarket self-checkout machines broken.
- Friday 21 July: Sam’s friends mocked Sam’s weight, hurting Sam and prompting a desire to change. On 27 July, Sam said they were working on health and getting active. Evan offered support and to work together. Evan said he had struggled with his health a few years earlier and persisted with changes; he shared a gym membership card as a reminder of his commitment. He said diet and lifestyle matter as well as exercise, and cutting sugary snacks and eating more fruit and vegetables had helped him substantially. He shared a produce photo. Sam was reducing soda and candy, found it hard, but was determined; Sam had tried and liked flavored seltzer. Evan suggested pairing seltzer with air-popped popcorn or fruit. Evan was reading *The Great Gatsby*. Sam planned to start regular gym exercise 28 July. Sam said Evan’s support meant a lot; Evan said he was there for Sam and encouraged them.
- 31 July–6 August: Evan traveled to Canada and met an unnamed Canadian woman. He said being with her made him feel alive; their time together was fun and energizing. On 7 August, Evan said he had been dealing with health issues, working on his health for two years with ups and downs; family motivated him, and health challenges made him value good moments. He shared a photo of his children playing on a swing set and said they brought him joy. He shared a cookie-container photo and said ginger snaps were his weakness. He recommended a fitness watch, saying it tracked progress, supported health goals, and visually motivated him. He said interesting hikes and adventure motivated him and shared a photo of a small island with a lone boat. He had a bonsai tree symbolizing strength and resilience; caring for it helped him through tough times and reminded him people could be tough even in little things. He said small acts of self-care, consistency, and perseverance help in the long run.
- 12 August: Evan’s son had a soccer accident and injured his ankle. Evan cared for him and took him to a doctor; it was initially rough to witness but not serious.
- 13 August: Evan said he had returned from a Canadian vacation with his new significant other; they hiked, biked, and explored outdoors. He shared a tent pitched in a grassy field. Sam said challenges were affecting Sam’s health and that supportive people like Evan helped them stay positive; Sam shared a photo of a notepad, pen, and note. Sam’s motivating quote was “Don't fear it, just take the first step,” encouraging healthier habits and progress over perfection. Sam said celebrating small victories mattered through setbacks. Evan had been searching for his keys for half an hour and said he lost them weekly. Sam offered to cheer him on after sleeping. Sam described a dream from the night of 12 August: soaring over skyscrapers and feeling incredible, and wondered what it meant. Evan suggested a dream-interpretation book. Sam said the ongoing journey felt endless sometimes but would be rewarding.
- 14 August: Sam made grilled salmon with vegetables, marinated with unspecified ingredients, and shared a photo.
- 15 August: Evan said his son’s ankle was improving but still sore. Sam reported a tough week and a doctor’s appointment that was a wake-up call to take better care of health; Sam gave no medical details, felt somewhat concerned and motivated, and was taking things step by step. Sam was taking a cooking class for healthier meals, enjoyed it, and learned recipes. Evan wanted to add vegetables to his meals and asked for recipes. Sam offered an easy roasted-vegetable recipe and more from class. Evan encouraged slow, small steps; Sam appreciated it and said they would continue.
- 19 August: Sam said a diet and healthier lifestyle were tough but gave them more energy and less post-meal sluggishness. Sam shared a bowl of spinach, avocado, and strawberries; liked grilled chicken and vegetable stir-fry with homemade sauce and offered the recipe. Evan had started painting classes a few days earlier and enjoyed them. A painting given by a friend had inspired him to begin painting; he joined classes to meet like-minded people, show his abilities, and improve. He said painting brought peace and self-expression and he was taking no other classes. Classes taught watercolor; instructor emphasized observing nature and painting what they saw. Evan found it a relaxing break from daily stress and especially liked landscapes, aiming to capture nature’s atmosphere and the peaceful feeling of being outdoors. Scenic places reminded him of car road trips. In July, he drove to Banff and skied; the views and snow were amazing and he hoped to return the next year. He enjoyed skiing, snowboarding, and ice skating. Sam wanted to try skiing but was unsure their body could handle it; Evan hoped Sam would join him for winter activities someday.
- Monday 21 August: Sam began a new diet and exercise routine and said it made a huge difference; Sam felt great.
- Friday 25 August: Evan twisted his knee; it was very painful and interfered with his usual fitness routine, which mattered greatly to him. He was considering physical therapy and hoped for an appointment soon. Meanwhile, he took it easy and swam to stay active.
- 27 August: Evan said a previously mentioned book kept getting better and he could not put it down; title unknown. Evan had taken a Rocky Mountains road trip in July, found the scenery stunning, and felt relaxed and refreshed by nature. Sam had not road-tripped in a long time, loved being surrounded by nature, wanted to hike more, and hoped to get healthier so a road trip and hike would soon be possible; Sam said hiking could be challenging. Evan found hiking calming and fun, suggested more hikes, and proposed they hike together. He recommended an unnamed lake with nearby trails, a two-hour drive from their location. Sam said a day trip was doable and planned to check it out.

**2023-09-11–10-17:** Sam shared before/after body photo; sugary cravings arose from stress, boredom and comfort-seeking. Phone navigation app malfunctioned; Evan suggested updating it. Evan had started weightlifting around 2022-10; advised Sam on form, trainer, light starting weights and gradual consistency. Evan’s favorite indoor hobby was watercolor. Week before 2023-10-06 he again injured knee playing basketball with his kids; PT helped somewhat, and he avoided intense workouts. On 2023-10-14 he shared a cliff-and-sunset painting; painting relaxed him.
Sam had work stress and bought unhealthy snacks, then felt guilty. Evan suggested kayaking; Sam was interested, and Sam and a mate near a lake planned to kayak. Sam traveled through Lake Tahoe, shared a kayak-by-river photo, and they agreed to plan a kayaking trip; Evan offered to suggest a spot. Around 2023-10-14–15 Sam went to ER with severe stomachache, diagnosed gastritis, and resolved to eat nutritiously and exercise regularly. Phone problems added stress by 2023-10-17; Evan’s response began by mentioning fitness, but the rest is unavailable.

**2023-11-09:** Sam became a Weight Watchers coach in their group, proud of this health milestone and hoping to motivate others. Evan congratulated and encouraged Sam. He apologized for missing events and said he’d had personal challenges. He shared a photo of a 1968 Kustom K-200A vintage guitar with strap, a gift from a close friend. Evan had lost his job the previous month due to company downsizing and was seeking a new one; he tried to stay hopeful. Sam offered emotional support. Evan shared a person walking on a beach with a surfboard at sunset: taken the previous Friday at his favorite peaceful beach near home, where waves and sunset help him unwind, especially in hard times. They agreed to visit together, planning for December 2023.

**2023-11-21:** Sam greeted Evan after a long gap. Evan said he’d had a health scare the previous week: a suspicious finding during a check-up led to a hospital visit, but it was a misunderstanding; doctors said he was fine. It made him appreciate life and monitor his health. Sam had discomfort limiting movement and was trying to change their diet, finding it hard. Sam shared a photo of a book showing a man, calling it their recent “feel good” flick. They agreed to appreciate something each day and the little things in life. Evan reassured Sam they could rely on one another.
Evan shared a photo of a group sitting around a fire pit, calling it wild/fun. Asked about fitness, he said he goes to the gym and takes his car out for a spin; Sam said fitness goals were hard to reach. Evan encouraged patience and persistence, then shared a small island with a lone boat. He said it was where he grew up and his happy place; it shaped him and remains dear to him. He also shared photos of sun shining through clouds over water, a person walking on a beach at sunset, and a sunset over water, describing the place as serene, calming, and paradise-like. They ended warmly; Evan reiterated he was there if Sam needed to talk.
